scientific_integrity: Analytical proof is based on Pontryagin conditions and Rolle zero counting; computational checks cover algebra only, not the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: General temporal-zero count assumes a transversal first exit and finite zeros of G; concrete example exits checked. This does not prove any computed two-switch candidate is a global minimizer or establish necessity of two switches. Earlier related switch-count work could contain an implicit analogue.
title: A finite-switch theorem beyond monotone SIR growth and two-switch completeness for state-dependent vaccination
